orgPanel.title: Change the proposal's organisation
orgPanel.intro: When the proposal was submitted on behalf of the wrong organisation. Co-organisers do not change; its sessions follow.
orgPanel.searchHint: Name, acronym or former name: every name is searched.
orgPanel.same: This is already the proposal's organisation.
orgPanel.done: The proposal now belongs to its new organisation.
orgPanel.membershipNote: The submitter is not added to the new organisation: memberships are managed from the organisation's page.

submitterPanel.title: Change the submitter
submitterPanel.intro: The person who follows the proposal and receives its notices. They must have an account; the contact person does not change.
submitterPanel.hint: The first three characters of the address are enough; the full address also finds someone hidden from the directory.
submitterPanel.none: Nobody matches. The person must already have an account.
submitterPanel.done: The proposal now has its new submitter.
submitterPanel.membershipNote: Their membership of the lead organisation is not set here: it is managed from the organisation's page.
